main_measure.name: t of mean (forecast/10) x (3-bar return minus coin mean 3-bar return), forecast < 0 cases, pooled over coins
main_measure.threshold: confirm if t >= 2 and the supporting check is negative; reject if t <= -2; minimum 100 independent forecast < 0 cases

supporting_check.name: mean excess 3-bar return of deeper half (forecast below median) minus shallower half

reading: The coin's mean 3-bar return is taken over all grid cases of all its windows; the median split is pooled over coins, with cases at the median in the shallower half.
